# PING-PONG - Martin Head - DREAMER 8 p.21 (PDF page 23) - CHIP-8 0200-036F (printed range 0200-0400)
# run C000 (FN 3). Pong against the computer, first to 21 wins.
# keys: 9 bat up, 1 bat down.
# CORRECTION (not a published erratum): printed 0250 = 72EE (key 1: bat -18) and 025C = 7201
# (key 9: bat +1 = down), contrary to the text (9 up, 1 down) and unplayable; the scan carries a
# reader's handwritten marks on exactly these two words. Fixed to 0250 = 7201, 025C = 72FF.
# difficulty: byte 030D = 03 (04 harder, 02 easier)
